content.short: Gem Wallet is an open-source crypto wallet with a DeFi focus.
content.description: Gem Wallet is an open-source wallet focused on DeFi. You retain full ownership, and the app does not access your data or funds. It prioritizes privacy by avoiding collection of personal information, wallet addresses, or asset balances. The project is entirely community-driven and has no investors, reinforcing transparency and user stewardship. By design, it protects crypto assets and private keys with industry-leading security measures, while remaining open-source and user-controlled.
